target: forge.sh — token order: FORGE_TOKEN env, FORGE_TOKEN .env, GITLAB_TOKEN env, GITLAB_TOKEN .env; first non-empty wins
cmd:
. "$FIXTURES/forge/setup.sh"; fx_init
fx_remote https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj.git
export FORGE_TOKEN=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001
P="/api/v4/projects/grp%2Fsub%2Fproj/merge_requests/7"
U=https://gitlab.example.test/grp/sub/proj/-/merge_requests/7
T1=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0001; T2=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0002
T3=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0003; T4=glpat-FAKE-not-a-real-token-0004
fx_http "GET $P" 200 '{"state":"merged"}'
step() { fx_reqs_clear; export FORGE_MOCK_EXPECT_TOKEN="$1"; fx_run pr-state "$U"; echo "$2: $(tail -1 "$FORGE_MOCK_DIR/token-match.log" 2>/dev/null || echo nolog) out=$FX_OUT"; }
printf 'FORGE_TOKEN=%s\nGITLAB_TOKEN=%s\n' $T2 $T4 > .env
export FORGE_TOKEN=$T1 GITLAB_TOKEN=$T3
step $T1 all
unset FORGE_TOKEN
step $T2 dotenvforge
printf 'GITLAB_TOKEN=%s\n' $T4 > .env
step $T3 envgitlab
unset GITLAB_TOKEN
step $T4 dotenvgitlab
export FORGE_TOKEN=
step $T4 emptyenv
unset FORGE_TOKEN; printf 'FORGE_TOKEN=\nGITLAB_TOKEN=%s\n' $T4 > .env
step $T4 emptydotenv
fx_done
